title: Relationship Statement — Farm Real Estate Loans Waiver on Class H Preferred Stock Dividend Reversals, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The reversal farm waiver shares the cost of the association's acceptance of the excess with borrowing members: on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock dividend reversal, a member with an active farm real estate loan whose principal balance is 250000 or more has 20 percent of the reversal waived; a member with an active farm real estate loan below that has 10 percent waived; any other member has none waived.

## Statement

| Member's Farm Real Estate Loans | Share of the reversal waived |
|---|---|
| An active farm real estate loan with a principal balance of 250000 or more | 20 percent |
| An active farm real estate loan with a principal balance below 250000 | 10 percent |
| No active farm real estate loan | None |

The waiver is read from the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records — the loan's status and principal balance. Waived percentages are summed into one percentage before it is applied: the reversal is charged at 100 less that sum, divided by 100, and rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Edges (hypothetical members)

| Farm real estate loan | Waived |
|---|---|
| Active, principal balance 250,000.00 | 20 percent |
| Active, principal balance 249,999.99 | 10 percent |
| Paid off and closed | None |
